QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] System Shutdown
QuestInfo.0: Only #bKrania#k, who you decided to drag along against her will, has the system access to shut down #bScion#k. Talk to Krania.
QuestInfo.1: You must go to the Central Control Room with \n#bSpencer#k and #bKrania#k to stop #bScion#k. Take out the Killer Androids that cross your path to make the way safe for Spencer and Krania to follow after you.
QuestInfo.2: #bKrania#k swears she stopped Scion. But if that's true, how were you moved elsewhere in the facility?

default.0: I'll follow after you with #bKrania#k. Can you bust up any Killer Androids and Heavy Equipment you come across on the way?
